{"notes":"DECIDED (Mark, 2026-10-22): smooth the flag day with a GPG fallback. Config order: keyringsrc = vouch: first, then the legacy GPG keyring (e.g. korg-pgpkeys .keyring); patatt already tries sources in order (src/patatt/__init__.py:1652-1657) and openpgp signatures already fall through to gpg. Fork addition: whenever a signature validates via any source other than vouch: (incl. the default gpg keyring), print a warning naming the legacy source and that it stops after the flag day's late cutoff. Fallback applies to everyone, registered or not. Removal = delete the legacy keyringsrc line after the late cutoff; no code change. Tests: registry-signed patch verifies via vouch: with no warning; GPG-signed patch from an unregistered and from a registered signer both verify with the warning; with the legacy line removed, GPG-signed patch fails.
Spike (docs/patatt-interop.md, 15b77de): vouch: is a new branch in get_public_key before the ref: check (P:1255-1257), ~35-line helper running 'git vouch keys', caching, openssh only; must return (b'<type> <base64>', keysrc) and turn EVERY failure into KeyError (b4 calls patatt unguarded, B:2323). Warning: ~5 lines after RES_VALID in validate_message (P:1669), only when a vouch: source is configured. Selector: 'k-' + lowercase hex fingerprint. Keep ci.sh green (ruff, ty, mypy, pyright, pytest, py3.9-3.15). Use upstream samples/openssh-signed.txt as an independent oracle.
DECIDED (review round): keyringsrc accepts exactly 'vouch:'; 'vouch:<dir>' is rejected with a warning and KeyError (not silently mapped to the default registry). Alternative: pass a registry dir to git vouch keys. Why: DESIGN.md and git vouch keys only offer the copy git vouch sync keeps. Identity is passed after '--' (i=-h@x made git vouch keys print usage, exit 0). Tests fail, not skip, when git-vouch is absent; fixture unsets XDG_DATA_HOME.
Mark 2026-10-23: (a) bare 'vouch:' only; no per-source registry path/url. Keys come only from the copy git vouch sync checks. Adding a form later is non-breaking."}
